Earnings Quality.description: Are the reported profits backed by real cash?
Earnings Quality.low: Profits may be on paper only

Forensic Risk.description: Warning signs of aggressive or manipulated accounting.

Financial Strength.description: Can the company handle downturns and repay its debts?

Profitability and Growth.description: How fast the company is growing and how well it earns on shareholders' money.

Cash and Capital Allocation.description: How much free cash remains after investing, and how it is used.

composite.description: Weighted blend of the five pillar scores ({weights}) that drives the verdict.

coverage.description: Share of this pillar's metrics that could be calculated from the uploaded file.
coverage.low: Low = score rests on little data

CFO / PAT.description: Cash from operations for every ₹1 of reported profit.

Accruals.description: Gap between profit and operating cash, as a share of total assets.
Accruals.good: {value} or less: profit is backed by cash
Accruals.watch: Above {value}: profit relies on non-cash items

Beneish M-Score.description: Statistical score estimating the likelihood of earnings manipulation; a warning signal, not proof.

Receivable days change.description: Change in how many days customers take to pay.
Receivable days change.watch: Up {value} or more: sales may be booked but not collected

Other income share.description: Part of pre-tax profit from non-core income such as interest or one-offs.
Other income share.watch: Above {value}: core earnings may be weaker

Altman Z''.description: Distress score blending liquidity, reserves, earnings and leverage.

Interest cover.description: How many times operating earnings cover interest payments.

Debt / Equity.description: Borrowings for every ₹1 of shareholders' funds.

Sales CAGR.description: Average yearly sales growth over the period available.

PAT CAGR.description: Average yearly profit growth over the period available.

ROE.description: Profit earned on every ₹100 of shareholders' money.

EBITDA margin trend.description: Change in operating margin across the period, in percentage points.

FCF / PAT.description: Free cash flow (operating cash minus estimated capex) as a share of profit.

Dividend payout vs cash.description: Share of operating cash paid out as dividends.
Dividend payout vs cash.watch: {value} or more: payout nears or exceeds cash generated

Cash / Borrowings.description: Cash balance for every ₹1 of debt.
